title: feat(algoliasearch): add support for algoliasearch v4
body:
<!--
  Thanks for submitting a pull request!

-->

**Summary**

This change add support for algoliasearch v4 to InstantSearch.js.

No changes were necessary in the code. Also since the client is mocked in the unit tests we did not add an extra job on CIrcleCI to test with the 2 versions of the client.

The examples were updated to use the latest v4 beta.

comments.body: `PlainSearchParameters` seems to have an issue in the helper still
Yes, we need to new helper v3 to fix this issue (same on React InstantSearch)
